versions.changelog: - Fix: the v1.0.3.0 sidebar entry didn't actually appear — Jellyfin gates main-menu items on `EnableInMainMenu`, not just `MenuSection`. Setting both now puts Show Tracker in the dashboard sidebar.
- Improvement: the Show Tracker page now appears as its own entry in the Jellyfin Dashboard sidebar (Server section), instead of being buried under Dashboard → Plugins → My Plugins → Show Tracker.

- Feature: clicking a show's poster or title in the dashboard now opens that show's page in your Jellyfin library (jumps straight to the seasons/episodes view). Expand/collapse on the rest of the row still works for inspecting missing episodes inline.

- Fix: the "Scan Now" button was partially covered by Jellyfin's fixed top-right header — the top and right edges intercepted clicks. The page now reserves padding to clear the AppBar and the Cast/Search/User icon cluster.

- Fix: dashboard page no longer stuck on "Loading scan results..." — corrected the embedded script's URL, moved inline styles into the page body so Jellyfin's config-page loader doesn't strip them, and normalized PascalCase responses on the client.
- Improvement: smarter episode comparison that handles libraries using a different season layout than TVMaze. Falls back to title/airdate matching, detects absolute (anime-style) numbering, and flags shows where the TVMaze match is likely wrong (e.g. anime vs. live-action remake with the same name).
- New per-show `MatchMode` and `MatchConfidence` fields, surfaced in the dashboard as a "Match info" note.

- Initial release
- TVMaze integration with rate limiting and caching
- Dashboard page with missing episode reports
- Scheduled nightly scanning
- REST API for external integrations

versions.changelog: v0.9.0 - Grande passe de durcissement issue d'un 3e audit ultra-complet (10 dimensions, revue adversariale multi-agents) : 6 corrections MEDIUM + ~29 durcissements LOW, 0 critique/eleve restant. Recommandee. PAS DE MIGRATION. Compatible Jellyfin 10.11.10 et 10.11.11. MEDIUM : (1) coller un emoji au ras d'une limite de longueur pouvait faire echouer la sauvegarde de config (500 ; troncature UTF-16 rune-safe) ; (2) annuler l'avertissement 'utilisateurs en streaming' n'efface plus silencieusement les modifs de l'onglet Maintenance et n'affiche plus un faux succes ; (3) modales Uptime Kuma / Import accessibles (role=dialog, focus piege, Echap, focus restitue) ; (4) reordonnancement des lignes au clavier (fleches haut/bas) ; (5) la couche d'enforcement anti-SSRF des webhooks est desormais couverte par des tests ; (6) le pipeline de release verifie que l'URL d'asset du manifest correspond (anti-typo de casse type v0.6.0). LOW notables : anti lost-update entre onglets, purge des utilisateurs supprimes du suivi 'vu', tailles de boutons bornees, coherence de planning fixe C#/JS, ARIA onglets + navigation fleches, contrastes et cibles tactiles WCAG, garde double-execution du script injecte, un seul fetch /maintenance par navigation, test de reflexion des tiers d'autorisation, coherence de version sur 4 sources. + 2 liens de documentation corriges. 391 tests verts, build 0 warning.

v0.8.5 - Corrections UX/a11y/fonctionnel issues d'un 2e audit ultra-complet (toutes couches : UX, design, perf, code, a11y, docs ; 0 critique restant, 6 high corriges ici). Recommande. HIGH : (1) les modeles rapides d'annonce (ex : Halloween/Noel 'annuel') perdaient silencieusement leur planning / auto-expiration / theme / image -> l'annonce s'affichait toute l'annee au lieu de sa fenetre ; desormais tous les champs sont copies. (2) L'overlay de maintenance plein ecran a enfin la meme accessibilite que les modales d'annonce : role=dialog + aria-modal, focus piege a l'interieur, scroll de la page verrouille, focus restitue a la fermeture (avant : un utilisateur clavier/lecteur d'ecran pouvait tabuler derriere l'overlay). (3) En mode carousel, les cartes non visitees n'etaient jamais marquees 'vues' -> le carousel reapparaissait a chaque connexion ; maintenant toutes les cartes sont marquees a la fermeture. (4) Un redemarrage programme a la fin de la fenetre de maintenance etait annule silencieusement par la desactivation auto du meme tick -> il se declenche desormais correctement. (5) `make bump` (outil de dev) etait casse sur GNU sed (Git Bash / CI Linux). (6) README : exigence Jellyfin corrigee 10.11.6 -> 10.11.10. MEDIUM : cap sur le NOMBRE d'elements des collections (annonces 200 / messages 100 / etc.) anti-bloat config.xml ; image hero d'annonce masquee si l'URL est morte (plus d'icone cassee) ; pluralisation '1 annonce'. TESTS : 366/366 verts (+3 caps), build 0 warning, revue adversariale multi-agents (aucune regression critique/elevee). Compatible Jellyfin 10.11.10 et 10.11.11. PAS DE MIGRATION.

v0.8.4 - Release de SECURITE + corrections (suite a un audit adverse multi-agents). Recommande pour tous. SECURITE (webhook SSRF, durci sur 3 couches) : la defense SSRF de v0.7.0 etait contournable. Corrige : (1) le HttpClient webhook suivait les redirections HTTP -> un hote public autorise pouvait renvoyer un 302 vers 169.254.169.254 (metadata cloud) / loopback / LAN ; desormais AllowAutoRedirect=false + un ConnectCallback qui re-valide l'IP REELLE de chaque connexion (bat aussi le DNS rebinding). (2) les litteraux IPv6-mappes (::ffff:169.254.169.254) et les hotes a point final (127.0.0.1.) contournaient la blocklist -> normalisation MapToIPv4 + trailing-dot. (3) ajout des plages ::, CGNAT 100.64/10, fec0::/10, broadcast. NB : configurer un webhook reste admin-only (RequiresElevation), donc l'attaque exige un admin malveillant ou piege. CORRECTIONS (audit) : (a) la desactivation manuelle de la maintenance n'est plus annulee par le planificateur (consommation du ScheduledStart passe + garde ScheduledEnd) ; (b) ajouter un user a la whitelist PENDANT la maintenance le reactive immediatement, le drift-check respecte la whitelist live ; (c) modele de concurrence APPLIQUE : tous les writers de config (SaveConfig/SaveMaintenance/SaveAdminAnnouncements/MarkSeen/ResetSeen + tache planifiee) passent par un verrou unique -> fin des pertes d'ecriture et du config.xml corrompu ; (d) les annonces recurrentes (daily/weekly/annual) sont evaluees en heure LOCALE serveur (etait UTC) -> elles s'affichent aux bonnes heures, alignees sur les bannieres (positionne le TZ du conteneur) ; (e) cap sur la taille de reponse webhook (anti-OOM) + try/catch global sur la tache planifiee ; (f) admin.js : fix d'une fuite de listeners (double-binding a chaque pageshow). CI : la garde ASCII attrape desormais U+2028/2029/0085 ; release.yml lance dotnet test avant de publier ; creation de release idempotente. TESTS : 363/363 verts (etait 316), correctifs SSRF mutation-verifies, revue adversariale multi-agents (aucune regression critique/elevee). PAS DE MIGRATION.

v0.8.3 - Release de durcissement qualite (reponse a un audit adverse). AUCUN changement de feature, AUCUN changement de comportement du plugin shippe : le DLL est fonctionnellement identique a v0.8.2. La seule modif du code shippe est un refactor interne behavior-preserving (extraction de MaintenanceHelper.SetUserDisabledAsync, la glue IUserManager.GetUserDto+UpdatePolicyAsync, factorisee depuis les 3 boucles activate/deactivate/drift-check) verifie equivalent par mutation testing. Tout le reste est de l'infra de test/CI qui ne part PAS dans le zip : (1) Garde anti-tests-vacuous via Stryker.NET (mutation testing) sur les helpers de logique pure (AnnouncementHelper + MaintenanceHelper), workflow dedie manuel+hebdo, seuil de non-regression. (2) +21 tests xUnit (295 -> 316) : durcissement HasUserSeen/MarkSeen, round-trip XML de PluginConfiguration (compat legacy + champs non-null), builders de payload webhook Discord/Slack/Generic, vecteurs XSS sur SAFE_URL_RE, et surtout 15 tests d'integration HTTP qui pilotent SaveConfig/SaveMaintenance/SaveAdminAnnouncements a travers un VRAI Plugin (BasePlugin sur dossier temp + XmlSerializer reel) avec preuve de persistance disque. (3) Smoke test de deploiement reel qui gate les releases : boot d'un vrai serveur Jellyfin (matrix 10.11.6 plancher targetAbi + 10.11.10 prod) avec le DLL monte, completion du wizard, auth admin, puis appel de /users-summary et /announcements/admin (les endpoints qui appellent IUserManager.GetUsers() - EXACTEMENT la methode qui crashait en MissingMethodException sur 10.11.9) + scan des logs serveur. Ce gate aurait attrape le bug v0.8.0 avant publication. TESTS : 316/316 verts sur SDK 10.11.10, refactor mutation-verifie (24/24 + nouveaux KILLED). PAS DE MIGRATION. Recommande pour 10.11.10+ ; equivalent fonctionnel a v0.8.2.

(5) Contraste WCAG AA sur badges - draft #E8A33D->#FFD27A + opacity 0.18->0.28, expired #D9534F->#FF8A87 + opacity 0.15->0.30, expiring + schedule-incomplete aussi rehausses. (6) Touch targets 44x44 minimum sur .jf-dconf-btn (padding 8->12) et .jf-url-btn (padding 7->12 + min-height 44 + inline-flex). (7) Focus visible outline doree sur les inputs .jf-ann-field. TESTS: 13 nouveaux cas xUnit (SanitiseExceptionMessage 7 cas redaction URL+host, TryGetRetryAfterSeconds 4 cas null/cap60s/delta/pastdate, IsTargetedAtUser_DraftWithRoleAndUuidFilters regression guard, IsScheduleActive_Daily_MidnightWrap_ExactBoundaries). 266 v0.7.0 -> 279 v0.8.0. v0.7.0 - Audit secondaire : 11 fixes (3 securite + 4 robustesse + 4 polish), 32 nouveaux tests xUnit (234 -> 266). (1) CRITIQUE banner.js checkTimeWindow overnight wrap : les banniers/annonces avec fenetre daily 22:00-06:00 retournaient toujours false, donc invisibles la nuit alors que le C# MatchesTimeWindow gerait correctement le wrap. Divergence client/serveur corrigee. (2) SSRF defense webhook URL : nouvelle helper IsWebhookHostSafe qui rejette loopback IPv4/IPv6 (127.0.0.0/8, ::1), link-local 169.254.0.0/16 (incl. AWS/Azure/GCP metadata endpoints), RFC1918 prive (10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16), IPv6 ULA fc00::/7, hostnames .localhost/.internal/.local, et localhost literal. Appliquee sur SaveMaintenance webhook URL ET TestWebhook endpoint. (3) WebhookNotifier log sanitization : SanitiseExceptionMessage strippe les URLs+tokens du message exception avant logging (LogWarning ne contient plus la URL discord avec son token). TestAsync retourne message generique a l'admin UI au lieu de ex.Message qui pouvait leak hostnames internes via SSL cert errors. (4) Init defensif Announcements + AnnouncementsSeen avec = new() property-level (en plus du constructeur) : XmlSerializer peut bypasser le constructeur sur XML legacy nil tags, laissant ces props null et causant NRE. (5) ValidateSchedules WeekDays empty/null : au lieu de rejeter (regression v0.6.1), auto-normaliser type='always'. Preserve la compat avec configs legacy qui avaient ce cas comme 'never-active' silencieux. (6) DetectFormat URL host parsing au lieu de substring match : avant, 'https://relay.com/discord-bot/api/webhooks/proxy' etait classifie Discord (faux positif). Maintenant utilise Uri.Host exact match (incl. canary.discord.com, ptb.discord.com). (7) GetActiveSessions snapshot ToList avant LINQ : evite race condition sur _sessionManager.Sessions collection mutable. (8) ClonePublicFields rendu internal + reutilise par MaintenanceScheduleTask au lieu de son snapshot field-by-field qui manquait ScheduledStart/End/ActivatedAt. (9) WebhookNotifier 429 Retry-After : respecte le header (en seconds ou HTTP-date), retry si <= 4s d'attente. (10) Webhook payload size cap 32KB : evite Discord/Slack/proxy 400 sur payloads trop gros (admin avec customTitle+customSubtitle+message tres longs). (11) banner.js tick() defensive null check sur CONFIG : si fetch /config fail (plugin disabled mid-session, network blip), CONFIG reste null et chaque CONFIG.* etait NRE. (12) LastModified monotone : Math.Max(old, now) protege contre les horloges qui reculent (NTP correction). TESTS : 32 nouveaux (15 cas checkTimeWindow overnight JS, 7 SSRF blocklist hosts, 6 boundary public ranges, 5 DetectFormat regression guards substring-match, ValidateSchedules WeekDays auto-correct 2 cas, NormaliseCssColor bounds revisited). 234 -> 266 verts.

Nouvelle classe CustomAnnouncementTheme persistee dans PluginConfiguration.CustomAnnouncementTheme avec 7 champs nullable : label, accentColor (hex), backdropColor (hex ou rgba), cardBackground (hex ou rgba), textColor (hex), fontFamily (whitelist : system|inter|jetbrains-mono|space-grotesk|manrope), borderStyle (whitelist : solid|glow|dashed|none). Champs vides = defaut Velours pour ce champ, donc partial customisation OK. 'custom' devient le 5eme thème dans la whitelist (selecteur global + override par annonce). Cote serveur : nouvelle helper NormaliseCustomAnnouncementTheme qui valide tous les champs et retourne null si tout est vide (drop automatique). Nouvelle helper NormaliseCssColor qui accepte hex + rgba() (necessaire pour les backdrops semi-transparents) avec regex strict anti-CSS-injection. Le client recoit le customTheme via /announcements/active, attache uniquement aux items qui ont theme='custom' (200 bytes economises par item sinon). Cote client banner.js : nouvelle fonction buildCustomThemeCss(t) qui genere les regles CSS dynamiquement, injectAnnTheme accepte un parametre customTheme avec re-injection auto quand le block change (admin tweak hot-reload via JSON signature). resolveAnnTheme retourne 'custom' tel quel (pas de fallback velours pour les annonces customisees). Le custom theme fonctionne dans les 3 modes (one-at-a-time, carousel, stack). Cote admin : nouveau bloc <details> repliable 'Editeur de theme personnalise' dans l'onglet Annonces avec 7 inputs grilles. Sauvegarde via le bouton Enregistrer global. 28 nouveaux tests xUnit : whitelist 'custom' dans NormaliseAnnouncementTheme, all-empty input -> null, partial valid input -> keeps valid drops invalid, fontFamily whitelist Theory (5 cas), borderStyle whitelist Theory (5 cas), NormaliseCssColor Theory (11 cas : hex 2 formats, rgba 3 variantes, rejet keyword/HSL/var/injection/null/empty). 185 tests v0.5.4 -> 213 tests v0.6.0 (+28). Pas de migration : CustomAnnouncementTheme est nullable, configs existantes chargent telles quelles.

v0.5.4 - Phase 2 annonces : viewport simulator admin. Nouvelle toolbar au-dessus de l'apercu live (section Apparence) avec 5 presets de viewport : Auto (largeur du panneau, defaut), iPhone portrait 375x667, iPhone paysage 667x375, iPad 768x1024, Laptop 1366x768, HDTV 1920x1080. Au clic, l'iframe redimensionne en taille fixe et l'info dimensions s'affiche en bas de la toolbar. La selection persiste en localStorage (jf-md-vp-preset) donc l'admin garde son choix entre refresh. JS initViewportSimulator() ajoute au boot, wire les boutons de la toolbar, applique la classe + update les indicateurs (active + dimensions). Aucun impact sur l'aspect runtime cote user final : le preset n'est qu'une regle CSS dans configPage.html, banner.js inchange. Le mode TV et Desktop dépassent souvent la largeur du panneau admin -> max-width:95vw + scroll horizontal pour permettre d'inspecter quand meme. 185 tests xUnit toujours verts (feature 100% client, backend C# untouched).

v0.5.3 - Phase 2 annonces : image hero. Nouveau champ optionnel ImageUrl + ImageAlt sur Announcement, rendu sous forme d' entre le meta header et le body de la modale annonce. Memes regles d'URL safe que ctaUrl (http/https/relatif, pas de //host). Cap 2000 chars pour l'URL, 200 pour l'alt text. Si vide, aucune image rendue (comportement identique a v0.5.2). Cote client : tag avec loading='lazy', alt={imageAlt ou title de fallback}, border-radius:8px et bordure subtile coherente avec le card. CSS scope dans injectAnnouncementStyles. Cote admin : nouvelle fieldset 'Image (optionnelle)' avec deux inputs (URL + alt text). Live preview admin rend l'image en temps reel pour valider l'apparence avant publication. Validation server-side dans SaveAdminAnnouncements rejette les schemes non-safe avec un 400. Mode carousel : chaque slide affiche sa propre image. Mode stack : chaque carte empilee affiche sa propre image, scroll continue donc pas de souci de hauteur. 2 nouveaux tests xUnit (defaults + round-trip preservation a travers SelectDeliverableForUser). 183 tests v0.5.2 -> 185 tests v0.5.3 (+2).

v0.5.2 - Phase 2 annonces : Schedule fixed/annual/weekly/daily. Les annonces beneficient maintenant du meme systeme de planning que les rotation messages des bannieres. Cinq types : always (par defaut, pas de filtre), fixed (fenetre de date precise YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM start/end), annual (recurrent par mois/jour avec optional time window, gere le wrap d'annee comme Christmas Dec 20 -> Jan 5), weekly (jours de la semaine au choix + fenetre horaire), daily (juste une fenetre horaire quotidienne, gere les fenetres overnight 22:00->06:00). Implementation : nouvelle helper C# AnnouncementHelper.IsScheduleActive(schedule, now) qui mirror exactement le JS isInSchedule existant des banner messages. Filtre ajoute dans IsTargetedAtUser. Validation SaveAdminAnnouncements reutilise ValidateSchedules existant. UI : fieldset 'Planning' ajoutee dans l'editeur d'annonce, reutilise les helpers getScheduleDetailHtml + wireScheduleEditor + populateSchedule + collectSchedule existants des rotation messages (composant identique, juste rendu dans un contexte different). Badge summary 'Planning' bleu affiche en plus du badge etat quand schedule != always : 'Fenetre fixe' / 'Annuel' / 'Hebdo: Lu Ma Me' / 'Quotidien 09:00-17:00'. Le client recoit la liste deja filtree, aucune logique client modifiee. 14 nouveaux tests xUnit couvrent IsScheduleActive : null/always (3 cas), fixed avec bornes ouvertes/fermees (4 cas), annual avec year-wrap Christmas (3 cas), weekly day-of-week + empty list (3 cas), daily avec overnight window Theory (8 cas), unknown type fallback, integration IsTargetedAtUser_RespectsSchedule. 169 tests v0.5.1 -> 183 tests v0.5.2 (+14).

v0.5.1 - Phase 2 annonces : brouillon + auto-expire. Deux nouveaux champs admin pour reduire la friction sur les annonces (preparation a l'avance + nettoyage automatique). (1) BROUILLON : nouveau toggle 'Brouillon' dans l'editeur, separe de Active. Une annonce en brouillon reste visible dans la liste admin avec un badge orange dashed, mais le serveur ne la sert jamais aux users finaux meme si Active est coche. Permet de preparer le contenu d'une annonce a l'avance puis de la publier en un clic en decochant Brouillon. Filtre serveur ferme dans AnnouncementHelper.IsTargetedAtUser : draft -> not delivered. (2) AUTO-EXPIRE : nouveau champ 'Expire apres (jours)' (1-365, vide = jamais). Quand renseigne, le serveur filtre automatiquement les annonces dont PublishedAt + ExpireAfterDays est passe. Filtrage stateless dans AnnouncementHelper.IsExpired : pas de mutation, pas d'auto-archive (l'annonce reste visible en admin avec un badge rouge barre 'Expiree' pour que l'admin sache pourquoi elle n'est plus servie). Cas limites : 0 ou negatif = traite comme 'no expiration' (drop a la sauvegarde par le clamp serveur). PublishedAt null = jamais expire (safe default). (3) BADGES SUMMARY : la pilule a droite de chaque ligne annonce affiche maintenant 5 etats possibles : Active (vert), Inactive (gris), Brouillon (orange dashed), Expiree (rouge barre), Active (Xj) (orange si <=7 jours avant expiration). Priorite : draft > expired > inactive > active. (4) VALIDATION SERVEUR : POST /announcements/admin clamp ExpireAfterDays a 1-365 (>365 -> 365, <=0 -> null) pour eviter typos 365000 ou negatif qui creerait une annonce permanenly-expired. IsDraft est un bool simple. (5) TESTS : 13 nouveaux cas xUnit couvrant draft never-delivered, expired filtre, IsExpired boundaries (-10j, -7j exact, -3j, 0j, days=0, days=-5), null PublishedAt safe default, integration SelectDeliverableForUser. 156 tests v0.5.0 -> 169 tests v0.5.1 (+13).

v0.5.0 - Phase 2 annonces partielle : modes carousel et stack enfin actifs cote client. Depuis v0.3.9 (Phase 1), le selecteur 'Mode d'affichage' de l'admin offrait 3 choix (one-at-a-time / carousel / stack) mais le client retombait toujours sur one-at-a-time quel que soit le reglage. v0.5.0 ferme la promesse : (1) CAROUSEL : si plusieurs annonces non vues a delivrer, le client affiche UNE modale avec deux chevrons gauche/droite et un compteur '1 / N' en bas. Chaque slide a son propre theme et accent applique a l'overlay (palette + police + animation), le marquage 'vu' fire-and-forget se fait quand on quitte la slide via fleches OU au close final. Navigation clavier : fleche gauche/droite, ESC pour fermer. Sur mobile (<=700px), les chevrons collapsent en bas de l'ecran. (2) STACK : toutes les annonces empilees verticalement dans une seule modale scrollable, avec header 'N annonces' et un seul bouton sticky 'Tout marquer comme vu' en bas. Pas de bouton 'Compris' par carte, c'est le bouton global qui POST /seen sur les N IDs en parallele. Mode utile quand l'admin a beaucoup d'annonces non-critiques regroupees. (3) Edge case respecte : si une seule annonce non-vue est disponible, le mode est ignore et on retombe sur la modale classique (pas de carousel-a-1-slide ridicule ni de stack-a-1-carte vide). REFACTOR : extraction de buildAnnouncementCardHtml(a, withOk) (fonction pure, retourne le HTML de la carte) et createAnnouncementOverlay(themeKey, accent) (cree l'overlay vide). Reutilises par les 3 modes (one-at-a-time + carousel + stack). buildAnnouncementModal devient un wrapper de 5 lignes. CSS : 26 nouvelles regles scopees via #jf-ann-overlay.jf-ann-carousel et #jf-ann-overlay.jf-ann-stack, zero impact sur le mode one-at-a-time existant (aucune regression sur v0.4.1). TESTS : aucun changement cote backend C# (la logique de selection annonce/mode est deja faite cote serveur). 156 tests xUnit toujours verts. Les pieges (banner.js ASCII-safe, escape \u2039 \u203a pour les chevrons) appliques.

v0.4.1 - Audit complet de revue de code apres v0.4.0 : 14 fixes appliques (1 securite + 13 qualite/perf/UX), 0 changement de comportement attendu pour les configs valides. SECURITE : (1) Faille XSS via URL protocol-relative dans les liens Markdown des annonces et des bannieres : `[click](//evil.com)` etait accepte par le regex `^(https?:\/\/|\/)` et generait `<a href="//evil.com">` qui navigue vers l'host attaquant. Fix client (banner.js linkSafeUrl + safeUrl ligne 510 + ctaUrl ligne 1848 + annMdRender admin.js ligne 3196) et serveur (IsUrlSafe BannerController.cs) avec lookahead `\/(?!\/)` qui rejette explicitement `//host`. Nouveaux tests xUnit pour `//evil.com`, `//evil.com/path`, `///triple-slash`. QUALITE : (2) Validation manquante des couleurs CSS sur ColorPresets / BannerMessage.Bg|Color / PermanentEntry.Bg|Color dans SaveConfig - un admin pouvait persister `red;position:fixed;top:0` (XSS CSS via inline-style). Nouvelle helper NormaliseHexColorOrDefault avec fallback typiquement-defaut. 7 tests. (3) ValidateRoutes rejette desormais les sequences `..` et `//` consecutives (defence en profondeur, route patterns Jellyfin n'en contiennent jamais). 8 nouveaux tests. UX : (4) Nouvelle modale `dangerConfirm` pour les actions destructives (suppression annonce, reset seen, activation maintenance avec sessions actives en cours) : remplace `window.confirm` par une vraie modale avec liste des elements affectes, conseil contextuel, et delai 2-3s sur le bouton danger pour empecher les clics accidentels. Style CSS dedie (.jf-dconf-*) avec animation, ESC pour annuler. PERF : (5) Refactor SelectDeliverableForUser de O(announcements x seenEntries x usersPerEntry) a O(announcements + seenEntries) via HashSet lookup (50k comparaisons sur 1000 users x 50 annonces -> ~1k). Test stress sur 100 annonces / 50 entries seen. ROBUSTESSE : (6) maybeShowAnnouncements capture le token dans une closure et revalide via getToken() apres le delai 800ms : si l'user logout pendant ce delai, le fetch programme est abandonne au lieu de tirer avec l'ancien token. (7) banner.js efface l'overlay annonce existant avant d'en construire un nouveau (race rafetch rapide). (8) postMessage live-preview (admin->banner.js) cible window.location.origin au lieu de '*'. (9) banner.js coalesce les bursts de md-preview-update via setTimeout 33ms (~30fps) : un parent malveillant ou un auto-save buggy ne peut plus pegger le CPU. (10) updatePreview admin debounced 120ms par keystroke au lieu de re-parser le markdown a chaque touche. (11) Validation des dates schedule sur Maintenance : rejet explicite des Invalid Date au lieu de comparaisons NaN <= NaN silencieuses. (12) togglePanel admin : iteration sur childNodes pour trouver le textNode (l'icon child cassait `.firstChild.nodeValue`). TESTS : 136 tests v0.4.0 -> 159 tests v0.4.1 (+23 : URL protocol-relative, hex color, route hygiene, perf stress).

v0.4.0 - Systeme de themes visuels pour les annonces. 4 themes au choix : Velours et Or (le look actuel, defaut), OLED Total Black (fond noir pur monochrome avec JetBrains Mono, ideal ecrans OLED), Glow Neon (halo color rotatif selon importance avec Space Grotesk geometrique futuriste et pulse animation), Glassmorphism (fond tres flou translucide avec Manrope rond elegant, look macOS / Vision Pro). 4 polices web premium embarques (140 KB total : Inter, JetBrains Mono, Space Grotesk, Manrope) servies par le plugin sous /MaintenanceDeluxe/fonts/ avec cache immutable 1 an. Selecteur de theme global dans Settings (s'applique a toutes les annonces par defaut) + override par annonce dans l'editeur (laisse 'Heriter' pour suivre le default, ou pick un theme specifique). Live preview admin re-rendue avec le theme actif et badge affichant quel theme s'applique (avec indicateur si override). 15 tests xUnit ajoutes pour valider la whitelist des cles de theme (cote serveur, comportement override null = inherit). Total 136 tests verts.

v0.3.13 - Modal annonce centree + premium + templates rapides. (1) Fix critique de centrage : la modal apparaissait en haut a gauche en mode toast au lieu de centree plein ecran. Cause : un ancestor Jellyfin (body ou skinBody) avec transform/filter/will-change creait un containing block pour position:fixed, qui se rattachait a cet ancestor au lieu du viewport. Fix : CSS hardcode avec !important + 100vw/100vh explicites + append a document.documentElement (html) au lieu de body pour echapper a tout transform parent. (2) Style premium : backdrop blur passe a 8px, fond rgba(0,0,0,.68) plus contraste. (3) Templates rapides : 7 modeles pre-remplis dans l'admin pour ajouter une annonce en 1 clic au lieu de tout retaper (Mise a jour serveur, Nouveaux films, Maintenance prevue, Amelioration perfs avec comparisons, Annonce communautaire, Evenement, Alerte critique). Bouton dedie par modele dans la section Annonces. Bouton 'Nouvelle annonce' renomme '+ Annonce vide' pour clarifier l'alternative.

v0.3.12 - Fix critique : la modal d'annonce ne s'affichait pas apres login. Le hook fetchAndShowAnnouncements ne tournait qu'une seule fois au load initial de banner.js. Si l'user etait sur la page login (pas de token) au moment du chargement du script, le code exit early avant le hook annonces. Apres login - SPA navigate vers home - le hook n'etait jamais re-trigger. Fix : nouvelle fonction maybeShowAnnouncements() idempotente (track token deja checke) appelee dans refetchAndApplyMaintenance qui s'execute a chaque navigation SPA (hashchange / popstate / viewshow). Au passage de login (no-token -> token), le hook se declenche automatiquement avec un petit delay 800ms pour laisser la home page se mounter visuellement. Reset auto du flag au logout pour que la prochaine connexion re-trigger. Aucune autre regression - le init initial fonctionne identique pour les users deja loggues au chargement.

v0.3.11 - Fix critical : cache busting des assets admin apres upgrade plugin. Le user a constate apres l'install de v0.3.10 que l'UI admin restait identique a v0.3.9 (layout casse, pas de live preview) parce que le browser servait l'ancien admin.js/admin.css depuis son cache (Cache-Control: max-age=300 introduit en v0.3.4). Reecriture du helper ServeEmbeddedAsset : utilise maintenant ETag base sur la version d'assembly + Cache-Control 'public, no-cache, must-revalidate'. Au lieu de cacher 5 minutes en aveugle, le browser revalide a chaque navigation via If-None-Match - 304 Not Modified si la version n'a pas change (zero body, tres rapide), 200 avec nouveau code si upgrade plugin detecte. Cette classe de bug 'stale admin UI apres upgrade' qui frappait v0.3.4-v0.3.10 est definitivement fermee : a partir de v0.3.11, chaque release force un fetch frais des assets sans intervention de l'admin.

v0.3.10 - Refonte complete de l'editeur Annonces. Trois fix critiques sur la Phase 1 de v0.3.9 : (1) Le bouton Enregistrer global ne sauvait pas les annonces - il ignorait POST /announcements/admin. Maintenant les 3 saves (config, maintenance, announcements) tournent en parallele via Promise.allSettled avec rapport d'erreur unifie. (2) Layout desordonne : les champs et les comparaisons s'empilaient n'importe comment a cause d'un grid mal defini avec emby-input. Reecrit en grid CSS 2 colonnes (form gauche, preview right) avec fieldsets thematiques (Identite / Corps / Etat / Cible / Comparaisons / CTA) + sub-grids responsifs (mobile 1 col, desktop 2-3 cols). (3) Aucune previsualisation. Ajout d'un panneau live preview a droite de chaque editeur qui rend la modal d'annonce telle qu'elle apparaitra cote user, avec accent colorise selon l'importance + comparisons en mini-table + footer. Mise a jour en temps reel a chaque keystroke. Plus : bouton 'Enregistrer cette annonce' dedie par row avec badge dirty pulsant orange (au lieu de l'auto-save invisible et fragile). 174 lignes de CSS dedie ajoutees dans admin.css (jf-ann-* + pv-*).

v0.3.9 - Annonces post-login (What's New modal) + markdown lien. Nouvelle fonctionnalite majeure : un systeme d'annonces dismissibles affichees aux utilisateurs apres login, idee pour pousser une mise a jour, un evenement, ou une release note enrichie. Chaque annonce a : titre + version + corps en markdown enrichi + icone + niveau d'importance (info/update/warning/critical avec accent colore distinct) + ciblage par role ET par UUID utilisateur specifique + comparaisons structurees avant/apres (Label/Before/After/Highlight) + bouton CTA optionnel. Tracking serveur : chaque utilisateur voit une annonce une seule fois (persistance serveur, pas localStorage). Bouton admin 'Reset vue par' pour re-afficher a tous. Markdown enrichi : ajout du support [texte](url) dans le corps des annonces ET des release notes maintenance existantes. URL safe-scheme (http/https/relatif), validation server-side. Modal client responsive : mobile portrait/paysage (stack comparisons), tablet, desktop (700px), TV (900px + font plus grand). Nouveaux endpoints : GET /announcements/active (any auth, retourne les non-vues filtrees par user), POST /{id}/seen (mark vu), GET /announcements/admin (full list + counts vu/total), POST /announcements/admin (save), POST /admin/{id}/reset-seen. 121 tests xUnit au total (89 + 32 nouveaux AnnouncementHelper). Documentation complete : docs/announcements.md. Phase 1 : seul le mode 'one-at-a-time' est implemente cote client, les modes carousel/stack arrivent en Phase 2.

v0.3.8 - Audit fonctionnel complet. NOUVEAU : pre-flight check sessions actives avant activation de la maintenance - un endpoint GET /MaintenanceDeluxe/active-sessions liste les users en train de streamer et l'admin UI affiche un modal de confirmation avec les noms + titres avant de couper le flux. NETTOYAGES : suppression du script mort scripts/check_inline_script.py (plus utilise depuis v0.3.7 ou l'inline JS a ete extrait), retrait du prefixe redondant '[MaintenanceDeluxe]' de tous les logs C# (depuis v0.3.7 BeginScope et le LogCategory remplissent deja ce role). REFACTOR : 359 lignes de CSS inline extraites de configPage.html dans Configuration/admin.css (EmbeddedResource + nouvel endpoint GET /MaintenanceDeluxe/admin.css public, meme modele de securite que admin.js). configPage.html passe de 1329 a 971 lignes (-27%, total -78% depuis v0.3.5). Factorisation des 3 endpoints d'assets (banner.js/admin.js/admin.css) en helper prive ServeEmbeddedAsset. CI : nouveau guard qui refuse tout retour d'inline style dans configPage.html (symetrique au guard inline script de v0.3.7). DOCUMENTATION : nouveau docs/banners.md documente complet le systeme de bannieres (rotation, permanent override, schedules 5 types, routes wildcards, color presets, dismiss cross-tab) qui etait sous-promu. README liste maintenant les 11 endpoints + pointe vers la doc.

v0.3.7 - Refactor qualite (suite audit). (1) Tests d'integration : extrait deux helpers purs supplementaires PartitionDeactivationTargets et SelectUsersNeedingReDisable dans MaintenanceHelper. La logique de deactivation et de drift check est maintenant 100% testable sans Plugin.Instance ni mock IUserManager. 6 nouveaux tests xUnit qui couvrent : classification 3-buckets (a re-enable/malformed/missing), input vide, all-valid, drift no-op (healthy), drift partiel, skip silencieux des malformes. 89 tests au total (83 v0.3.6 + 6 nouveaux). (2) Logging structure : BeginScope ('Activate', 'Deactivate', 'DriftCheck') sur les operations multi-step de MaintenanceHelper, plus LogTrace pour le drift no-op (debug ciblé sans pollution Information). (3) Refactor majeur configPage.html : 3048 lignes de JS inline extraites dans Configuration/admin.js (EmbeddedResource + endpoint GET /MaintenanceDeluxe/admin.js public, meme modele de securite que banner.js). configPage.html passe de 4376 a 1329 lignes (-70%). CI adapte : remplace l'extraction du inline JS par node --check direct sur admin.js, plus une regle qui refuse tout retour de inline script dans configPage.html. Le risque historique des fix critiques v0.1.11/v0.1.12 (admin UI cassee par parsing JS inline) est definitivement clos.

v0.3.6 - Apercu admin agrandi : la carte remplit maintenant la zone visible. Quand l'admin clique 'Agrandir l'apercu' dans le panneau Apparence, la carte de prevue s'elargit pour occuper l'espace disponible (max-width 1400 px ou 92vw selon le plus petit) au lieu de rester en mode compact 640 px et de paraitre perdue dans le fond aurora. Implementation : postMessage 'md-preview-expanded' du parent admin vers l'iframe au moment d'entrer/sortir du mode agrandi, banner.js applique une classe CSS jf-md-preview-expanded dediee uniquement valide en mode live-preview. Le rendu cote utilisateurs finaux Jellyfin reste totalement inchange (la classe n'est jamais appliquee hors preview admin).

v0.3.5 - Tests integration + bump GHA actions. (1) Couverture tests : refactoring leger de MaintenanceHelper qui extrait deux pure functions IsAdmin / IsDisabled / SelectUsersToDisable / SelectPreDisabledIds, plus 9 nouveaux tests xUnit qui verifient que la partition utilisateurs (admins / pre-disabled / whitelistes / a desactiver) est correcte dans tous les cas (incluant l'invariant critique disjoint des deux listes). 83 tests au total (74 v0.3.4 + 9 nouveaux). Aucun changement de comportement observable cote runtime, juste l'organisation interne plus testable. (2) GHA actions bumpees aux versions actuelles : actions/checkout@v6, setup-dotnet@v5, setup-node@v6, setup-python@v6 (etaient en v4/v4/v4/v5). Le FORCE_JAVASCRIPT_ACTIONS_TO_NODE24 ajoute en v0.3.4 retire car les nouvelles actions ciblent Node.js 24 nativement.

v0.3.4 - Polish post-audit (suite v0.3.3). (1) UX webhook : nouvelle checkbox 'Notifier avant un redemarrage serveur' dans le tab Maintenance pour piloter le NotifyOnRestart ajoute en v0.3.3 (par defaut active). (2) Drift check : log Information liste maintenant les usernames des comptes ré-disabled (plus juste les UUIDs), debug nettement plus rapide. (3) Headers HTTP : X-Content-Type-Options nosniff sur GET /banner.js et GET /preview.html ; X-Frame-Options SAMEORIGIN sur /preview.html ; Cache-Control public max-age=300 sur /banner.js. (4) Workflows GHA : opt-in Node.js 24 via FORCE_JAVASCRIPT_ACTIONS_TO_NODE24=true (les runners forceront Node 24 par defaut en juin 2026 et retireront Node 20 en septembre 2026). (5) Documentation : docs/webhooks.md mentionne maintenant l'evenement Restarting + champ NotifyOnRestart + warning host non-Discord/Slack ; README liste tous les endpoints API + flag ?md-debug=1.

v0.3.3 - Audit complet du plugin : 12 fixes (2 securite + 8 robustesse + 2 polish). (1) Securite : GET /config retourne desormais un DTO BannerClientConfig sans webhook URL ni listes UUID (etait lisible par tout user authentifie) ; nouvel endpoint GET /config-admin (RequiresElevation) pour la page admin. (2) Securite : drift check periodique (toutes les 1 min) qui re-disable tout user re-enable manuellement pendant la maintenance, sans attendre le prochain restart serveur. (3) Rate-limit /test-webhook simplifie en single-timestamp global atomique (plus de memory leak, plus de bypass derriere reverse proxy). (4) Cache-Control max-age=10 sur GET /maintenance pour reduire la charge de polling. (5) JS Injector retry exponentiel 5/15/45/120/300/600 s (~18 min) au lieu de 3x5s, avec try/catch propre dans le Task.Run. (6) MaintenanceScheduleTask refactore : single Plugin.Instance read par tick, plus coherent. (7) SaveMaintenance : single SaveConfiguration au lieu de double save (fenetre de race fermee). (8) Webhook URL : log warning si host non Discord/Slack (generic webhooks toujours acceptes). (9) Borne sup scheduledRestart a 30 jours pour eviter les configs polluees. (10) Nouvelle notification webhook Restarting avant un restart serveur planifie + champ NotifyOnRestart (default true). (11) escHtml admin : ajout de l'apostrophe au escape map. (12) console.debug du banner.js guard derriere ?md-debug=1. 13 nouveaux tests xUnit (74 au total).

v0.3.2 - Power-user features + filet de securite tests. (1) Export / Import config JSON : bouton Exporter dans le tab Maintenance qui telecharge la config en JSON (URL webhook strippee par <redacted>). Bouton Importer ouvre une preview modal avec validation (refus si webhook URL pas redacted). L'import touche que le formulaire, le serveur reste intact tant que tu n'as pas clique Enregistrer. (2) Uptime Kuma helper : bouton 'Construire depuis Uptime Kuma' a cote du champ URL de statut. Modal qui demande l'URL de l'instance + slug, genere l'URL finale et permet de la tester via HEAD no-cors. (3) Validation contraste WCAG : warning soft sous le picker de couleur d'accent si le ratio avec le fond est < 4.5:1 (norme AA). Calcul de luminance relative selon la formule officielle WCAG 2.1. (4) Projet de tests xUnit : 61 tests unitaires sur les fonctions pures (DetectFormat, NormaliseHexColor, NormaliseTheme, NormaliseAnimationSpeed/ParticleDensity/BorderStyle, NormaliseReleaseNotes, IsUrlSafe). Etape dotnet test ajoutee au workflow CI - aucune PR ne pourra plus casser une normalisation sans s'en rendre compte. (5) CHANGELOG.md au format Keep a Changelog avec backfill complet depuis v0.2.0.

v0.3.1.1 - Patch CSS sur la liste blanche : les checkboxes natives Jellyfin (is='emby-checkbox') chevauchaient les noms d'utilisateurs en mode flex. Le widget passe en grid 2 colonnes (checkbox 1.6em fixe + label flex), checkboxes HTML natives avec sizing explicite, plus de chevauchement possible quel que soit le nombre d'utilisateurs.

v0.3.1 - Webhooks Discord/Slack + whitelist utilisateurs. (1) Notifications webhook : envoie un payload HTTP a chaque activation/desactivation de maintenance. Format Discord, Slack ou JSON generique auto-detecte depuis l'URL. Bouton 'Tester la notification' avec rate-limit 1 appel/5s par IP. URL HTTPS uniquement (pas de http://). Si le webhook est down, la maintenance s'active/se desactive quand meme - le webhook ne peut jamais bloquer le toggle. Doc payloads : docs/webhooks.md. (2) Liste blanche utilisateurs : nouveau widget multi-select dans la section Maintenance qui liste tous les utilisateurs Jellyfin. Les utilisateurs coches conservent leur acces pendant la maintenance (parfait pour la famille, l'astreinte, un compte de test). Les utilisateurs supprimes apparaissent en italique avec un bouton 'Retirer'. Edge case : un user ajoute apres l'activation reste desactive jusqu'au prochain toggle. (3) Privacy : l'endpoint public /MaintenanceDeluxe/maintenance ne renvoie plus les listes UUID (whitelist, disabled, pre-disabled) ni l'URL webhook - elles ne fuitent plus aux callers anonymes. Le admin UI passe par /config (auth) qui contient le state complet. (4) Backend : nouveau WebhookNotifier statique avec timeout 5s + 1 retry. Endpoint POST /maintenance/test-webhook et GET /users-summary, tous deux RequiresElevation.

v0.1.13 - UI FIX: gold card border was truncated when release notes made the overlay taller than the viewport. The card had its own internal scroll (max-height:92vh) so the ::before gold gradient didn't extend through scrolled content. Fix: overlay scrolls instead of card, card grows to full content height so the border wraps everything, and background layers (blobs, beams, grain, particles) are pinned to viewport with position:fixed.

v0.1.12 - CRITICAL FIX: Save button stopped reacting as soon as any field was modified. Root cause: a TypeError in collectMessages() aborted initDom before the Save handler got wired, because release-note rows shared the .jf-msg-row class with rotation messages and had no .jf-msg-detail. Fix: excluded .jf-rn-row from the rotation collector + defensive null guard in collectRowData.

v0.1.11 - CRITICAL FIX: admin config page was entirely unresponsive since v0.1.8. Root cause: release-note templates had real newlines inside JS string literals, causing the whole inline admin script to fail parsing. Every button, input, and save handler silently died. Now fixed — admin UI fully interactive again, tested with node --check.

v0.3.0 - Quality release: bug fixes + anti-data-loss + French admin UI. (1) Bugs: BannerController endpoints now return 503 if the plugin instance is not yet initialised instead of serving phantom defaults; ScheduledRestart is preserved when set after a maintenance window (only cleared if it was inside the window); MutationObserver and hideScrollObserver are now properly torn down on pagehide (no more memory leak after long sessions); live-preview postMessage receiver enforces same-origin checks (no cross-origin injection of overlay config). (2) Anti-data-loss: orange dot badge next to Save when there are unsaved changes, browser warning if you try to close the tab with unsaved changes, automatic localStorage draft autosaved every 500ms with restore prompt on next load, inline validation that flags scheduledEnd before scheduledStart and scheduledRestart in the past. (3) French admin UI: the Maintenance tab, Save button, save-confirmation modal, alerts and validations are fully translated to French. (4) The live-preview iframe now shows a clear fallback after a 5s timeout if the iframe never reports ready.

v0.2.3 - Two polish fixes on the new Appearance panel. First, the 'Agrandir l'apercu' button used Jellyfin's default emby-button which rendered with a white background on the dark admin theme; it now uses the same neutral-translucent style as the Reset button so it fits both light and dark themes. Second, new 'Rotatif' border option: a luminous gold gradient that slowly spins around the card, paired with a soft pulsing glow. Speed follows the animation scale slider (including the 'off' toggle).

v0.2.2 - Fine-tune beyond the presets. Every Animation speed and Particle density preset now has a companion numeric input (0-5× scale for animations, 0-500 for particle count). Click a preset to fill the number; type a number to override with any value in-range. Layout: appearance preview is now sticky (it follows you as you scroll the controls column), iframe min-height bumped to 540px so long release notes fit, controls column is tighter, expand-mode settings panel narrowed from 340px to 300px so the preview gets more room.

v0.2.1 - Polish on the new Appearance section: live preview iframe now loads correctly (the preview shell and banner.js endpoints no longer require Authorization headers that browsers don't send on iframe navigation, fixes 401 errors). The three enum selectors (animation speed, particle density, card border) are now segmented pill controls instead of plain radio buttons - much more readable and consistent with modern UI. Reset appearance button restyled so it is legible on both light and dark themes. Appearance labels, alerts and preview copy translated to French.

v0.2.0 - Appearance customization with live preview. New admin section lets you pick accent color, background tint, card opacity, animation speed (off/slow/normal/fast), particle density (none/low/normal/dense), and card border style (full gradient / simple gold / none). A live preview iframe reflects every change instantly without saving. Expand button gives a fullscreen view with toggleable settings panel (H hotkey) and Esc to exit. All colors are now derived from a single accent pick, so the palette stays coherent whatever hue you choose.

versions.changelog: - The events endpoint now requires an administrator or an API key on both Jellyfin and Emby.

- Jellyfin builds now target .NET 10 against the Jellyfin 12.0 plugin ABI. Jellyfin 12 moved the server to .NET 10 and changed several plugin interfaces, so a 10.11 build does not load on it. Catalog entries carry `targetAbi` 12.0.0.0, which hides them from 10.11 servers; 0.4.1 stays the last release for 10.11.
- Emby is unaffected. `Emby.Plugin.Sse` is still netstandard2.0 and still targets Emby 4.9+.

- Emby dashboard thumbnail is the 16:9 catalog tile instead of the square Tracearr logo.
- Catalog art replaced: a 1920x1080 tile shared by the Jellyfin catalog and the Emby thumb, and an Emby terminal preview showing the wire format. The old images were Tracearr app placeholders.
- Both catalog manifests describe the full event set and carry per-version release notes; new releases pull them from this changelog.
Adds server.stats CPU/RAM samples every 6 seconds while a client is connected, and task.started, task.progress, and task.completed events from the scheduled task manager.
Adds library.item.added and library.item.removed events carrying itemId, itemType, and parentId.
Adds the hello event on connect, disconnects subscribers whose buffer fills so they reconnect and resync, raises the per-subscriber buffer to 512, and makes release builds report their real version.
First release: playing, progress, paused, stopped, session.start, and session.end events plus a ping keepalive every 30 seconds.

name: LDAP Authentication [✓✓]
description:
Authenticate your Jellyfin users against an LDAP database, and optionally create users who do not yet exist automatically.
Allows the administrator to customize most aspects of the LDAP authentication process, including customizable search attributes, username attribute, and a search filter for administrative users (set on user creation). The user, via the "Manual Login" process, can enter any valid attribute value, which will be mapped back to the specified username attribute automatically as well.

Add support for 12.1

# 🚀 A New Foundation for File Transformation File Transformation **3.0.0.0** is a major overhaul of how the plugin integrates with Jellyfin. The transformation system has been rebuilt around standard ASP.NET Core middleware, removing much of the version-specific runtime patching that File Transformation previously relied on. Alongside **Jellyfin 12 support**, this release drops support for **Jellyfin 10.10.7** and lays a much more maintainable foundation for future Jellyfin releases. > ## 🙌 Huge thanks to @4eh5xitv6787h645ebv > > A massive part of this release is thanks to **@4eh5xitv6787h645ebv**, who took on the major overhaul of File Transformation's core architecture in PR #58. > > The move away from the old Harmony/MonoMod-based interception system to standard ASP.NET Core middleware is a significant piece of work. It not only makes File Transformation substantially easier to maintain, but also resolves an entire class of compatibility problems that caused the plugin to malfunction or be disabled on certain Jellyfin versions and platforms (#20, #35, #62, #64, #70, #71). > > This is far more than a small patch or isolated feature - it fundamentally improves the foundation the plugin is built on. A huge thank you for the time and effort that went into it. ## ✨ New Features * Added support for **Jellyfin 12** and the newer Jellyfin server architecture (#34). * Replaced the previous Harmony/MonoMod-based web interception system with standard ASP.NET Core `IStartupFilter` middleware (PR #58, @4eh5xitv6787h645ebv). * Added support for unregistering transformations through `PluginInterface.RemoveTransformation(Guid)`, allowing dependent plugins to cleanly remove transformations when required. * Added support for synthesising virtual files for registered transformation paths, restoring support for plugins such as Plugin Pages where the underlying file doesn't physically exist. * Added ETag generation and `304 Not Modified` support for transformed content. * Added Brotli and gzip recompression of transformed responses for remote clients. * Added automatic MIME type detection for virtual transformed files. ## 🛠️ Improvements * Removed platform-specific DLL extraction and version-specific Jellyfin shims. * Removed dependencies on Harmony, MonoMod and Prometheus from the core transformation pipeline. * Improved compatibility across Jellyfin versions and platforms by moving the transformation system onto standard ASP.NET Core APIs (#20, #35, #62, #64). * Added per-transformation error isolation so a failure in one plugin's transformation won't prevent other transformations from running. * Made transformation registration, removal and execution thread-safe. * Added regex caching and timeout protection for transformation matching. * Improved handling of `Accept-Encoding`, including proper quality-value (`q`) parsing. * Improved LAN detection for IPv6-mapped IPv4 addresses. * Improved proxy caching behaviour by correctly setting `Vary: Accept-Encoding`. * Reworked HTTP handling to use a shared `HttpClient` with appropriate timeouts. * Hardened named-pipe transformations with timeouts, size limits, EOF handling and improved resource cleanup. ## 🪲 Bug Fixes * Fixed a class of failures where Harmony/MonoMod runtime patching could cause File Transformation to malfunction or be automatically disabled on startup (#20, #35, #62, #64, #71). * Fixed #70 where transformations could attempt to use a disposed `IServiceProvider` after Jellyfin restarted, resulting in `500` responses across the web UI. * Fixed transformed content potentially retaining stale trailing bytes when a transformation produced a shorter result than the original response. * Fixed failures in one transformation potentially breaking the entire transformation pipeline. * Fixed potential `HttpClient` resource leaks. * Fixed named-pipe transformations being able to hang indefinitely or loop on zero-byte reads. * Fixed incorrect handling of disabled compression encodings such as `gzip;q=0`. * Fixed failed virtual-file transformations returning an empty successful response instead of reverting to the original `404`. * Improved middleware failure handling so the original response is served if transformation or recompression fails. ## 💻 Developer Compatibility The existing `PluginInterface.RegisterTransformation` API and registration payload remain compatible with previous releases, so plugins using a standard transformation callback **should not need to change how they register transformations**. There are, however, some changes to transformation execution that plugin developers should be aware of: * Added `PluginInterface.RemoveTransformation(Guid)`, allowing plugins to explicitly unregister a previously registered transformation. * Assembly callbacks still receive the same payload and are expected to return the transformed content as a `string`. * Invalid or failed assembly callbacks now **fail safely rather than falling through to another configured callback mechanism**. Plugins should ensure their callback assembly, class and method names are valid. * HTTP transformation callbacks must now return a **successful HTTP status code**. Non-success responses are treated as a failed transformation rather than using the response body as transformed content. * HTTP callbacks now have a **15 second timeout**. * Named-pipe callbacks now have connection/error handling and a **50 MB maximum response size**. * Failed transformations now leave the original response untouched rather than potentially replacing it with invalid or partial output. These changes are intended to make transformations significantly safer and more predictable, but plugins relying on the previous fallback or error behaviour should review their integrations when updating. ## ⚠️ Compatibility * **Jellyfin 10.10.7 is no longer supported.** * Added support for **Jellyfin 12** and its newer server architecture (#34). * Users remaining on Jellyfin 10.10.7 will need to stay on an earlier File Transformation release until they upgrade Jellyfin. * Removed legacy Harmony/MonoMod runtime patching and version-specific Jellyfin shims. * File Transformation now relies on standard ASP.NET Core middleware rather than patching Jellyfin internals, providing a much more stable base for future Jellyfin versions. ## Contributors * 4eh5xitv6787h645ebv ## ❤️ Support If you enjoy using my Jellyfin plugins and want to support the time that goes into building, maintaining, and improving them, you can do so on [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/IAmParadox27). Thank you for using the plugins and being part of the community.

# 🎬 Media Bar Arrives on Jellyfin 12

Media Bar **3.0.0.0** brings support for **Jellyfin 12**, including compatibility with both the classic desktop experience and Jellyfin's newer modern web layout.

> ## 🙌 Huge thanks to MakD and the upstream contributors
>
> Media Bar itself is the work of **MakD and the contributors to the upstream Media Bar project**. The plugin I maintain is primarily a Jellyfin wrapper around that work, exposing configuration and integration points so it can be installed and managed cleanly as a Jellyfin plugin.
>
> A huge amount of effort has gone into keeping Media Bar working across Jellyfin's changing web interface, especially for Jellyfin 12. The features, UI work and frontend improvements in this release are built on that upstream work, and the credit for that belongs to **MakD and everyone contributing there**.
>
> My part is largely packaging, integrating and exposing that work through Jellyfin's plugin system.

## ✨ New Features

* Added support for **Jellyfin 12**.
* Added support for Jellyfin 12's **modern React/MUI home screen layout**, alongside the existing classic desktop layout.
* Updated the bundled Media Bar frontend to the latest Jellyfin 12-compatible upstream version.
* Added Jellyfin 12-specific styling so Media Bar integrates correctly with the new web-client shell while retaining the existing appearance on the classic layout.
* Media Bar continues to ship its frontend assets directly with the plugin, ensuring the version displayed in Jellyfin matches the plugin version you've installed.

## 🛠️ Improvements

* Synced Media Bar with the latest Jellyfin 12-compatible upstream work.
* Improved Media Bar placement within the Jellyfin 12 home screen across both supported layouts.
* Improved layout behaviour on taller displays, ensuring Jellyfin's home-screen rows remain below the Media Bar content rather than overlapping its controls.
* Improved localisation handling when loading Jellyfin's translation chunks.
* Retained support for the **Get updates early** option for users who explicitly want to track unreleased upstream Media Bar changes.

## 🪲 Bug Fixes

* Fixed Media Bar being inserted in the wrong position when using Jellyfin 12's modern layout (#181).
* Fixed translated Media Bar strings falling back to English or producing JSON decoding errors for some languages (#185).
* Fixed home-screen rows overlapping Media Bar buttons on taller viewports.
* Fixed Jellyfin 12 layout differences that could cause Media Bar to render incorrectly compared with Jellyfin 10.11.

## ⚠️ Compatibility

* **Media Bar 3.0.0.0 supports Jellyfin 10.11.11 and Jellyfin 12.**
* Users on older Jellyfin 10.x versions should remain on a compatible **2.x** Media Bar release.
* Jellyfin 12 support includes both the **classic Desktop layout** and the newer **modern React/MUI layout**.
* A compatible **File Transformation 3.x** release is required.
* If you're using the **Get updates early** option, unreleased upstream Media Bar changes may behave differently from the frontend bundled and tested with this plugin release.

## Contributors

* austinnorgaard
* judarange

If you enjoy using my Jellyfin plugins and want to support the time that goes into building, maintaining, and improving them, you can do so on [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/IAmParadox27).

Thank you for using the plugins and being part of the community.

# 🧭 Plugin Pages, Ready for Jellyfin 12 Plugin Pages **3.0.0.0** brings the plugin forward for **Jellyfin 12**, updating the way custom pages are injected into the Jellyfin web client and fixing the user-facing plugin settings flow for Jellyfin's latest architecture. This release also drops support for **Jellyfin 10.10.7**, while introducing a new plugin-facing API that makes it much easier for other plugins to add and manage their own pages. ## ✨ New Features * Added support for **Jellyfin 12**. * Added a new public **Plugin Interface** allowing other plugins to register pages programmatically through `PluginInterface.RegisterPage(JObject)`. * Added `PluginInterface.RemovePage(string id)`, allowing plugins to unregister pages they previously registered. * Updated Plugin Pages' web-client injection to work with the changes introduced in Jellyfin 12. * Updated user-facing plugin settings pages to work with Jellyfin 12. * Updated the underlying Jellyfin dependencies and integration points required by the new server/web-client architecture. ## 🛠️ Improvements * Reworked page injection to account for changes to the Jellyfin 12 web client. * Improved compatibility for plugins that use Plugin Pages to expose user-facing pages inside Jellyfin. * Updated the user plugin settings integration so pages opened through Jellyfin's user menu continue to behave correctly on Jellyfin 12. * Dependent plugins can now manage their pages at runtime rather than directly modifying Plugin Pages' configuration. * Cleaned up legacy compatibility code that is no longer required now that older Jellyfin versions are being dropped. ## 🪲 Bug Fixes * Fixed custom plugin pages failing to inject correctly into the **Jellyfin 12** web client. * Fixed user-facing plugin settings pages not working correctly on Jellyfin 12. * Fixed cases where pages registered through Plugin Pages could result in a **Page not found** experience after Jellyfin web-client changes. * Fixed compatibility issues caused by changes to Jellyfin's client-side routing and page-loading behaviour. ## 💻 Developer Compatibility Plugin Pages now provides a public plugin-facing API for registering and removing pages. * `PluginInterface.RegisterPage(JObject)` can be used to register a page directly with Plugin Pages. * The supplied `JObject` is deserialised into Plugin Pages' `PluginPage` model and registered immediately with the page manager. * `PluginInterface.RemovePage(string id)` can be used to unregister an existing page by its ID. * Plugins no longer need to directly modify `Jellyfin.Plugin.PluginPages/config.json` in order to dynamically add their own pages. * Plugins can now register pages during startup and remove them again during shutdown or when their configuration changes. This should be considered the **preferred integration path for dependent plugins going forward**, replacing direct manipulation of Plugin Pages' configuration where possible. The new API is additive, so existing configuration-based integrations are not inherently broken by the update. Plugin developers are, however, encouraged to migrate to the new interface for cleaner lifecycle management and better compatibility with future Plugin Pages releases. ## ⚠️ Compatibility * **Jellyfin 10.10.7 is no longer supported.** * Added support for **Jellyfin 12**. * Users remaining on Jellyfin 10.10.7 will need to stay on an earlier Plugin Pages release until they upgrade Jellyfin. * Plugin Pages continues to require a compatible version of **File Transformation**. * Plugins that depend on Plugin Pages should also be updated to versions compatible with Jellyfin 12. * The new `PluginInterface` is additive; plugins using the previous configuration-based approach can continue to work, but the programmatic API is now the recommended integration method. ## ❤️ Support If you enjoy using my Jellyfin plugins and want to support the time that goes into building, maintaining, and improving them, you can do so on [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/IAmParadox27). Thank you for using the plugins and being part of the community.

# 🔥 The Biggest Home Screen Sections Update Yet This is the biggest Home Screen Sections update to date, bringing a substantial set of new features, fixes, localisation improvements, and internal changes alongside support for Jellyfin 12. With this release, Home Screen Sections is moving to **3.0.0.0**, marking a major step forward for the plugin and laying the groundwork for future Jellyfin versions. ## ✨ New Features * Added support for **Jellyfin 12**, including updated dependencies and compatibility changes required by the new Jellyfin version. * Added a new **Collections** section to display collections from the user's library. * Added a new **Recently Added In Library** section, allowing recently added media to be displayed for individual libraries, including custom libraries such as Anime (#231). * Added routing to supported sections, allowing section headers such as Genre to link through to their relevant Jellyfin pages. * Added per-section settings, allowing individual sections to have their own configurable behaviour. * Improved **Because You Watched** recommendations with a scoring system to better prioritise similar titles. * Added an option for **Recently Added Shows** to display either shows or individual episodes (#38). * Added an option to filter Upcoming sections based on the user's Jellyfin library access (#214, PR #249, @n00bcodr). * Added warnings when required plugin dependencies cannot be found (#234). * Added separate admin display names for sections, allowing their names to be translated without affecting the title displayed on the home screen. * Integrated with the new **Plugin Pages PluginInterface**, allowing Home Screen Sections to manage its Plugin Pages integration programmatically. ## 🛠️ Improvements * The **Modular Home** menu entry is now registered dynamically through Plugin Pages rather than relying on static Plugin Pages configuration. * The Modular Home page can now be added and removed as part of Home Screen Sections' own lifecycle, reducing the chance of stale or missing Plugin Pages entries. * Improved the reliability of the **Modular Home** link and its integration with Jellyfin's user-facing plugin settings flow. Previous releases have seen cases where the link was missing or resulted in a `Page not found` page. * Home Screen Sections now respects libraries a user has chosen to hide from their home screen, filtering them from relevant sections (PR #237, @gemcdaniel). * Improved compatibility with newer Jellyfin versions by updating library handling and dependency integration. * Improved library filtering to account for changes to `VirtualFolderInfo` in Jellyfin 12. * Improved recommendation behaviour and section configuration through the new per-section settings system. * Improved support for mixed-content and custom libraries across more section types. * Improved Home Screen Sections' handling of temporary user caches, including validation, expiry and automatic cleanup. * Added additional localisation keys throughout the configuration interface to make more of the plugin translatable. ## 🪲 Bug Fixes * Fixed #269 where cached lazy-load pages could be accessed using a hash created for another user. Added validation, automatic cache cleanup and expiry handling for temporary user caches. * Fixed #268 where the image cache directory wasn't recreated if it was removed while Jellyfin was running. * Fixed #258 by requiring authorization for the section registration endpoint. * Fixed #247 where `/HomeScreen/Sections` could crash when Modular Home was enabled without any globally configured sections. * Fixed #242 where the scroll listener could leak and gradually cause the browser to slow down during long sessions. * Fixed #240 where duplicated file transformations could cause sections to appear multiple times and make configured upper limits, such as Because You Watched's Upper Limit, appear to be ignored. * Fixed #241 where mixed-content libraries weren't supported by the majority of sections. * Fixed #149 where Watch Again, Because You Watched and Genre could fail to return TV series or episodes because queries filtered on parameters which weren't always populated. * Fixed #226 where the Genre section didn't respect the Hide Watched setting (PR #227, @jrhigueras). * Fixed **My Requests** returning unrelated library items when a user had no requested items (PR #246, @jamesmhoward1357). * Fixed library filtering on Jellyfin 12 where `VirtualFolderInfo.ItemId` is no longer populated. * Fixed SkiaSharp dependency compatibility with the newer Jellyfin/.NET stack. * Fixed the Genre section appearing as `{0} Movies` in the admin interface. ## 🌐 Translations * Added **Norwegian Bokmål** translations (PR #239, @dyviknilsen). * Expanded and updated **Polish** translations (PR #235, @TheMatrixan). A large number of new settings, sections and localisation keys have been added in this release. As a result, **some supported languages may not yet have translations for every new string** and may temporarily fall back to English in parts of the plugin. Translation contributions are very welcome! ## 💻 Developer Compatibility The public Home Screen Sections section-registration interface remains compatible with previous releases. * `PluginInterface.RegisterSection(JObject)` is unchanged. * Existing plugins registering custom Home Screen Sections do not need to adopt a new registration payload for this release. * Home Screen Sections itself now consumes the new **Plugin Pages PluginInterface** to register its user-facing Modular Home page dynamically. * Plugins integrating with both Home Screen Sections and Plugin Pages should prefer the new programmatic Plugin Pages API rather than directly modifying Plugin Pages configuration. ## ⚠️ Compatibility * **Jellyfin 10.10.7 is no longer supported.** * Added support for **Jellyfin 12**. * Users remaining on Jellyfin 10.10.7 will need to stay on an earlier Home Screen Sections release until they upgrade Jellyfin. * Updated dependencies and internal APIs to align with newer Jellyfin versions. * Home Screen Sections requires compatible releases of **File Transformation** and **Plugin Pages**. * The public Home Screen Sections `PluginInterface.RegisterSection` contract remains compatible with previous releases. ## Contributors * n00bcodr * jrhigueras * jamesmhoward1357 * gemcdaniel * dyviknilsen * TheMatrixan ## ❤️ Support If you enjoy using my Jellyfin plugins and want to support the time that goes into building, maintaining, and improving them, you can do so on [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/IAmParadox27). Thank you for using the plugins and being part of the community.
